name: Black Bear
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: pp. 222–223 in v2, Black Bear Traits.
heading: Black Bear Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: Brown Bear refers to Black Bear on p. 225. Polar Bear has its own player trait block and is outside this profile.

name: Boar
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Boar Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: Giant Boar refers to Boar on p. 234. The printed Charge adds damage without the encounter boar's prone save. The design notes' optional Athletics proficiency is not a species trait.

name: Camel
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Camel Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: The player stat block grants no water or endurance mechanic. Rillglass takes Athletics through Outlander, not the species upgrades floated in the design notes.
Kamstra p. 7 uses conventional unarmed strikes with the monk damage die for Martial Arts and Flurry of Blows bonus attacks.

name: Cat
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Cat Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: The player Cat is Small and the trait block omits Keen Smell. The design notes mention Tiny size and Keen Smell, and the encounter Cat is also Tiny.

name: Constrictor Snake
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 226 in v2, Constrictor Snake Traits.
heading: Constrictor Snake Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
sourceDistinctions: Giant Constrictor Snake refers to Constrictor Snake on p. 234. The printed player trait has only walking speed and does not automatically restrain a grappled target. The design notes mention a climb speed, and the encounter version has a swim speed.
